# Flow: workspace members and teams
Load when: decision row 10

## Preconditions
1. LPM API key: full or custom for member add/remove and team delete; portfolio for team create/rename. Connector → core rule 2 (`list_workspace_members` is the only people tool on a connector).
2. Workspace members: `list_workspaces` → `access.canManage == true`, or the memberId is you (leave). Teams: callerUserId (SKILL.md §3: `list_api_keys` → `userId`; else ask the user) equals `get_team` → `ownerId`, or has `owner`/`admin` in `list_team_members`; delete: `ownerId` only. The server does not check `update_team` or `delete_team`: you are the guard. callerUserId unknown → ask; never compare against a guessed id.
3. Roles and least privilege: [roles](roles.md). Effects of removals: [destructive-ops](destructive-ops.md). No tool lists all users or finds one by email: ask for the LPM user id.

## Steps
### A. Workspace members (row 10)
1. `list_workspace_members`(workspaceId) → keep `id`, `userId`, `userEmail`, `role`. Add and the person is listed → report the role and STOP.
2. Add: follow SKILL.md P2 (userId from the user; `get_user`(userId) → keep `email`, `displayName`; role `member` or `viewer`, `owner`/`admin` only when the workspace owner asked). Remove: target is `get_workspace`(workspaceId) → `ownerId`, or the last owner/admin → STOP: "Ownership transfer is not supported through MCP."
3. Show the call with all arguments (write userEmail=(from get_user), never the address) and its effect (add: access to every workspace project at once, no notification sent); on "yes": `add_workspace_member`(workspaceId, userId, userEmail=get_user `email`, role) [C] / `remove_workspace_member`(workspaceId, memberId) [C]. Role change = remove, then add, under one confirmation naming both calls. Never change your own role (callerUserId): the add fails once your manage right is gone. Add fails after the remove → STOP and report "<person> removed; re-add failed: <error>" to the workspace owner.
4. Not idempotent: after an error or timeout re-run step 1 before any retry ("User is already a workspace member" = already added). Verify: `list_workspace_members`(workspaceId) → the person has the requested `role`, or is absent; a role change → one row for the person, with the new `role`.
### B. Teams (row 10)
5. `list_teams`() → keep `id`, `name`, `ownerId`. Create: same `name` → reuse; else `create_team`(name, description) [A] → keep `teamId` after "ID: "; timeout → step 5 before any retry.
6. Rename: `get_team`(teamId) → callerUserId owns or admins it (Precondition 2) → show the call; on "yes" `update_team`(teamId, name and/or description only) [C]. Never send `ownerId`.
7. Add: `list_team_members`(teamId) → not listed; `get_user`(userId) → `email`; show the call; on "yes" `add_team_member`(teamId, userId, userEmail, role="member") [C]; tell the user it sends a "Team invitation" notice.
8. Remove: memberId from `list_team_members`(teamId), never the team `ownerId`; show the call; on "yes" `remove_team_member`(teamId, memberId) [C].
9. Delete (callerUserId == team `ownerId` only): show `get_team`(teamId), `list_team_members`(teamId), `list_projects`(teamId); ask "Delete team <name>? No undo; member records stay orphaned and <N> projects keep its teamId. (yes/no)"; on "yes" `delete_team`(teamId) [C].
10. Verify: `list_teams`() / `list_team_members`(teamId) → the new name, member or role is present; removed or deleted ids are absent (`delete_team` reports success even for an unknown id).

## Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| role `owner` or `admin` not asked by the workspace or team owner | "Owner/admin gives full management rights. Did the owner ask for it? Otherwise I use member." |
| removing the workspace owner, the last owner/admin or the team owner | STOP: "Ownership transfer is not supported through MCP." |
| you are not the team owner/admin, or callerUserId is unknown | ask the team owner / "What is your LPM user id?" |
| you are asked to change your own workspace role | STOP: "Ask another workspace owner/admin to change your role." |
| `add_workspace_member` fails after the remove | STOP: report "<person> removed; re-add failed: <error>" to the workspace owner |
| user id unknown | "What is the LPM user id of <person>?" |

## Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| workspace member add / remove / role change | `list_workspace_members` | `role` as requested, or the person is absent |
| team create / update / delete; team member | `list_teams` / `list_team_members` | name and `role` as requested; removed or deleted ids absent |

## Report fields
Scope (workspace / team), Done (people and roles before → after), Evidence (re-read), Pending (member add: "tell <displayName> directly: LPM sends no notification"), Next (exactly one action, never "none"). Name people by `displayName` + userId; never paste an email or `hourlyRate`. Write in the user's language.
